en.headline: HKU Faculty of Arts launches inaugural Being Human Festival
en.dek: The free public programme runs until 15 November with workshops, performances and talks under the theme Crossroads at venues including Tai Hang.
body: The Faculty of Arts at the University of Hong Kong is leading the inaugural Being Human Festival in the city, which begins today and runs through 15 November.

Organised under the theme Crossroads, the festival brings together university researchers and local arts practitioners for free public events that include workshops, walks, conversations, performances and shared meals at venues on and off campus.

One of the projects is the Being Human Fizz Hub in a Tai Hang storefront, exploring fermentation and food preservation, with an opening mixer scheduled for this evening from 5pm to 8pm. Other activities include mind-controlled drone experiences, lantern-making workshops and poetry events.
The University of Hong Kong said the festival aims to help people understand themselves and their relationships through humanities research made accessible to the wider community.

zh.headline: 港大文學院首辦「人文藝術節」今日起至15日
zh.dek: 主題「十字路口」的免費公眾活動包括工作坊、表演及對談，場地涵蓋大坑等地。
body: 香港大學文學院今日起至11月15日舉辦首屆「人文藝術節」，為國際人文研究盛會首次在亞洲舉行。
藝術節以「十字路口」為主題，由大學研究人員聯同本地文化藝術界別，於校園內外多個場地舉行免費公眾活動，包括工作坊、步行導賞、對談、表演及共餐。
其中大坑地舖的「人類活力中心」項目探討發酵與食物保存，今晚5時至8時舉行開幕酒會。其他活動包括以腦電波控制無人機體驗、花燈製作工作坊及詩歌朗誦等。
港大表示，藝術節希望透過把人文研究帶進社區，讓市民更了解自身及與他人的關係。
